title: Generic resource graph full expansion
goal: Prove a single sequential expansion path for the generic resource graph, starting with process-graph and pipes/stdio support and then continuing through service process trees, Unix sockets, timers/signals, file locks, inotify/fanotify, mmap-backed files, epoll readiness, generic database/data-dir safety, same-arch continuation, and cross-arch semantic reconstruction. Every support claim must be target-native, exact-shape, descriptor-backed, covered by happy-path and refusal matrix proof rows, registered in inventory/docs/coverage, and bounded by explicit non-claims. No arbitrary process restore, broad daemon/service/database migration, source-ISA emulation, metadata-only success, or runtime-profile shortcut may be claimed.
